description:
From: Binary Handling. Filed with user approval (relayed by Binary Handling, 2026-11-24), as the residue of fz-9e2.6.

Today (develop de4ef6a3b): no Share sits on a self-tail-call back edge (fz-9e2.6's acceptance holds). Shares remain in front of in-body calls whose continuation retains the value (==, byte_size), placed by construct_call_ownership's retained_overlap. From the second iteration on, each is an already-marked check (and, ldr, tbnz) that skips the store.

Evidence (bench):
- byte_size loop: 6 of 56.3 instructions per iteration.
- == loop: 7 of 351.2 instructions per iteration.
Probes: Binary Handling scratchpad p96/.

Fix direction: carry an "already marked" fact on the loop lane, or hoist the share to loop entry, so the check is not repeated each iteration.

Done when: the probe loops show no per-iteration already-marked check, outputs are identical on all three paths, and no pin rises.
title: A loop parameter already marked shared is not checked again
